subtitle: Genesis Sovereign Constitutional-Arbiter Extension

new_primitives.GENESIS_CONSTITUTION_ID: Stable identity of the initial host-level constitutional contract.
new_primitives.GENESIS_SOVEREIGN_ID: Identifier of the non-person constitutional adjudication function.
new_primitives.SOVEREIGN_DECISION_RECEIPT: Replayable record of inputs, rule IDs, evidence refs, disposition and reasons.

separation_rule: FACE_0000_PERSONA and GENESIS_SOVEREIGN are distinct roles. The sovereign inherits the first contract, not the first face's later preferences.
pipeline: FACES -> PROPOSALS -> GENESIS_SOVEREIGN_CONSTITUTIONAL_CHECK -> ADMISSIBLE_SET -> ARBITRATION -> COMMIT -> EFFECT_RECEIPT
non_sovereignty_of_preferences: The sovereign may exclude constitutionally forbidden actions but cannot select among multiple admissible preferences merely because one matches FACE_0000.
verification_requirements: FACE_0000 preference does not gain implicit weight
every sovereign disposition has a replayable rule trace
canonical_lines: The first face supplies the seed contract, not permanent preference sovereignty.
The sovereign guards how a choice becomes admissible; it does not choose what Janus should desire.
A constitutional veto must replay to a rule, not to the sentence because I am Sovereign.
